content_units: Cozy Friday Night Movie Match
Here are 8 strong picks that fit your vibe: character-driven, lightly suspenseful, low on gore, under 2h 20m, English or Korean, and emotionally engaging without getting too bleak.
Ranked Movie Picks
Option 1:   Knives Out   (2019, English, 2h 10m)   A witty mystery with sharp characters, playful suspense, and a very satisfying payoff.     Best with friends
Option 2:   Decision to Leave   (2022, Korean, 2h 18m)   A beautifully acted romantic mystery that stays tense and absorbing without relying on gore.     Best solo
Option 3:   The Nice Guys   (2016, English, 1h 56m)   Its lovable mismatched leads and breezy detective plot make it a cozy suspense-comedy pick.     Best with friends
Option 4:   Searching   (2018, English, 1h 42m)   A clever, fast-moving missing-person thriller that is emotionally grounded and easy to get pulled into.     Best solo
Option 5:   Burning   (2018, Korean, 2h 28m)   Brilliantly character-focused and mysterious, but it slightly misses your runtime limit, so it’s the one trade-off pick.     Best solo
Option 6:   Game Night   (2018, English, 1h 40m)   A fun, twisty comedy-thriller with just enough suspense to stay exciting while keeping the mood light.     Best with friends
Option 7:   The Farewell   (2019, English/Mandarin, 1h 40m)   More warm drama than thriller, but its intimate character work and gentle emotional tension make it ideal for a cozy night.     Best solo

Option 8:   A Hard Day   (2014, Korean, 1h 51m)   A tightly paced Korean thriller with strong character pressure and suspense, but still far less graphic than typical crime films.     Best with friends
Best Fits for Your Exact Preferences
-   Most balanced overall:     Knives Out
-   Best Korean pick:     Decision to Leave
-   Lightest and most fun:     Game Night
-   Best if you want stronger tension:     Searching
-   Best comfort-watch energy:     The Nice Guys
Viewing Notes
- I prioritized movies that feel engaging rather than heavy or grim.
-   Burning   is the only near-miss because it runs a bit over your limit; everything else fits or stays very close to your runtime preference.
- If you want the safest “cozy Friday” trio, go with   Knives Out  ,   Game Night  , or   The Nice Guys  .
